featured_reviews.name: Renu Chudamani
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother recently had her cataract operation done at Ayush / Dr Agarwal’s eye clinic. Here’s an honest review of her experience.

1. Location: 5-stars - the location of the clinic is conveniently right at the beginning of postal colony, and although some road work was going on further down, it didn’t impact our ability to get in and out of the clinic with ease. The clinic is located on the first floor, even though there are 3 elevators, taking the stairs might be easier than the long wait for the elevator.
2. Facility: 4-stars: The entire place is kept very clean and tidy by a group of busy house keeping staff. The only gripe I had was the bathrooms did have an issue with water running from one of the hoses in the one stall. I also saw did see a cockroach (!!). However, I must say that when house cleaning was informed they took action right away.
3. Convenience: 5-stars: All in one clinic, you have your consultations, eye prescriptions, all ophthalmologist  related tests as well as two operating rooms make this truly a convenient experience. No need to run to another location to get anything.
4. Wait times: 4-5- stars: Varies, although we were seen within 15-20min for most of our appointments. On the day of the surgery we were seen almost right away.
5. Doctors: 5-stars: Dr Nita Shah is amazing, loved her calm reassuring demeanor and she was a realist, she didn’t try to give any false promises. She answered questions patiently even after a busy day of operations and seeing patients in the OPD. Stellar attitude, totally recommend this doctor!
6. Front-house/Triage Staff: 5-stars:  Ms Amrita went out of her way to help my mother, and comfort her about the procedure. She was patient with any questions, and helped square away questions about insurance, and what needed to be sent over. She even was able to help us offline with questions over WhatsApp. Really appreciated her help, and she was a big reason for why my mother wanted to get her cataract done at this location. Always smiling, fast and efficient, she truly is a star employee. Ms Snehanka was also a great help, she worked quickly to get us out of the hospital post surgery helping get prescriptions filled and ensuring payments are done on time.
7. Nurses: 4-stars: I think it’s here that the hospital can do some more work. The nurses are a little disorganized and although I think they’re all pretty competent it would be good for a ticketing system or something similar rather than someone calling out your name when your expected to move from station to station. On multiple occasions I saw that they mispronounced the patient names (no fault of theirs!!) but this led to some confusion. Also, there was some attitude from some of the nurses, I realize they had a heavy workload, so maybe something to look into with training and the hours they’re working.

Overall my mom had  great experience, pre and post op. Thank you!
P.S: One thing I did want to mention - they do have a screen up so you can watch your loved one’s cataract operation while it’s happening. Not for the faint of heart, and completely optional, it’s only through the window to the exclusive waiting room for patients that you can view this.

Is vision loss running in your family? It could be Inherited Retinal Dystrophy (IRD).

Inherited Retinal Dystrophy is a group of genetic eye disorders that gradually damage the retina, leading to progressive vision loss. Early symptoms often include difficulty seeing at night, poor vision in dim light, tunnel vision, light sensitivity, or blurred central vision.

Because these conditions develop slowly, they are often mistaken for common vision problems, delaying diagnosis and treatment.

At Centre For Sight, our retina specialists use advanced diagnostic technologies, including Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), visual field testing, Electroretinography (ERG), and genetic testing, to accurately diagnose inherited retinal disorders and recommend the most appropriate management plan.

Advanced Eye Technology: How Modern Diagnostics Improve Eye Care

Advanced eye technology is transforming the way eye conditions are detected, monitored, and treated. Modern diagnostic systems help eye specialists identify vision problems earlier, assess eye health with greater accuracy, and create personalized treatment plans for every patient.

From detailed retinal imaging and corneal mapping to advanced screening for glaucoma, cataracts, and refractive errors, cutting-edge technology enables safer, more precise, and more effective eye care.

Regular eye examinations combined with advanced diagnostic tools can help detect potential issues before they affect your vision, ensuring timely intervention and better long-term outcomes.

Book your comprehensive eye examination at Centre For Sight and experience the benefits of technology-driven eye care.

How Long Does LASIK Last? Understanding Long-Term Vision Correction

LASIK is designed to permanently reshape the cornea and correct vision problems such as myopia, hyperopia, and astigmatism. For most patients, the results are long-lasting, with clear vision often maintained for 10–20 years or even longer.

A common misconception is that LASIK "wears off" over time. In reality, the surgical correction remains permanent. However, natural age-related changes such as presbyopia (difficulty reading up close after 40), cataracts, or other eye conditions can affect vision later in life.

Patients with stable eye power, healthy corneas, and appropriate candidacy typically experience excellent long-term outcomes. In cases where vision changes significantly, enhancement procedures may be considered after a thorough evaluation.

If you're considering LASIK or want to learn whether you're a suitable candidate, consult our refractive surgery specialists for a comprehensive assessment.

Healthy Vision Supports Better Learning & Development in Children

Good vision plays a vital role in a child’s learning, confidence, and overall development. Clear eyesight helps children read comfortably, stay focused in class, participate actively in activities, and perform better both academically and socially.

Many vision problems in children can go unnoticed because kids may not realize their vision is different from normal. Difficulty reading, frequent eye rubbing, headaches, squinting, or poor concentration can sometimes be signs of an underlying eye condition.

Regular pediatric eye examinations can help detect vision issues early and support healthy visual development during the growing years.

Give your child the advantage of clear vision with timely eye check-ups and expert eye care.

Migraine Aura: When Visual Disturbances Need Attention

Seeing flashing lights, zigzag patterns, blind spots, or shimmering lines before a headache may be a sign of migraine aura. These temporary neurological symptoms can occur before or during a migraine and, in some cases, even without a headache.

While migraine aura is usually not dangerous, new or unusual symptoms such as sudden vision changes, speech difficulties, one-sided weakness, or symptoms lasting longer than an hour require prompt medical evaluation.

Understanding your symptoms and getting the right diagnosis can help rule out other eye or neurological conditions and ensure appropriate management.

If you experience recurring visual disturbances or unexplained vision changes, consult a specialist for a comprehensive evaluation.

Common retina disorders include diabetic retinopathy, retinal detachment, macular degeneration, macular holes, and retinal tears. Many of these conditions respond better when diagnosed and treated early.

featured_reviews.name: Macson Almeida
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mom had a cataract in both eyes and I was worried about having the procedure during the COVID-19 Pandemic. To add to that, mom was worried about the surgery and she was not very keen on doing the procedure. We met one surgeon in Mulund and a friend recommended Dr. Ronak Solanki's Neoclarity Eye and Dental Care in Byculla. Even though it was in Byculla, I decided to take mom there as I trusted my friend. I was immediately happy with this decision as in the first meeting, Dr. Ronak put my mom's worries at ease. The way he spoke to her and reassured her was incredible. Truly a doctor who cares about his patients and goes to great efforts to put them at ease. It was also evident that he took safety seriously as he allowed one patient in his clinic at the time for consultation. With the OT conveniently situated next door. during the procedure, there was nobody else at the clinic. The clinic was also sanitized at regular intervals. My mom went for the procedure with full confidence in Dr. Ronak.
I am grateful to him and his team for all the efforts they took. Mom's vision is now restored completely and she is happy. I would certainly recommend Neoclarity to anyone who wants assurance of quality service, professionalism and safety, especially during the current pandemic.
